Sizes.name: Mini
Sizes.description: A small, compact vehicle, easy to maneuver and park.

Sizes.name: Small
Sizes.description: A small vehicle with limited space, suitable for personal transport.

Sizes.name: Medium
Sizes.description: A standard vehicle size, offering a balance of space and maneuverability.

Sizes.name: Large
Sizes.description: A larger vehicle with increased capacity and durability.

Sizes.name: Huge
Sizes.description: A very large vehicle, suitable for carrying heavy loads or multiple passengers.

Sizes.name: Gargantuan
Sizes.description: An enormous vehicle, often used for military or industrial purposes.

Sizes.name: Colossal
Sizes.description: A gigantic vehicle, capable of withstanding significant damage and carrying large loads.

Features.name: Autopilot
Features.description: The vehicle can pilot itself, using its own Vehicle skill of 4 per rank.

Features.name: FTL Radio
Features.description: A faster-than-light communication system for real-time interstellar contact.

Features.name: Reinforced Frame
Features.description: Strengthens the vehicle's frame, increasing its durability.

Features.name: Stealth Technology
Features.description: Allows the vehicle to avoid detection through various means.

Features.name: Submersible Capability
Features.description: Enables the vehicle to operate underwater.

Features.name: All-Terrain
Features.description: Equips the vehicle to traverse a variety of terrains without difficulty.

Features.name: Energy Shield
Features.description: Provides additional protection by generating a defensive energy field.

Features.name: Sensor Array
Features.description: A comprehensive array of sensors for detecting environmental changes and threats.

Features.name: Weapon Mounts
Features.description: Allows the vehicle to be equipped with various weapons.

Features.name: ECM (Electronic Countermeasures)
Features.description: Countermeasures to disrupt enemy electronic systems.

Features.name: EMP Resistance
Features.description: Protects the vehicle's electronics from electromagnetic pulses.

Features.name: Self-Repair Systems
Features.description: Automated systems that allow the vehicle to repair itself over time.

Features.name: AI Co-Pilot
Features.description: An artificial intelligence system that assists in piloting the vehicle.

Features.name: Escape Pod
Features.description: A small, detachable pod for emergency evacuation.

Features.name: Improved Handling
Features.description: Enhances the vehicle's maneuverability.

Features.name: Ram Prow
Features.description: A reinforced front end designed for ramming other vehicles.

Features.name: Remote Control
Features.description: Allows the vehicle to be controlled remotely.

Features.name: Transponder
Features.description: A device that transmits the vehicle's location for tracking purposes.

Features.name: Dual Size
Features.description: The vehicle has an interior size larger than its exterior.

Features.name: Rooms
Features.description: The vehicle includes additional rooms such as an infirmary or living space.

Features.name: Hidden Compartments
Features.description: Concealed storage areas within the vehicle.

Features.name: Alarm
Features.description: An alarm system that activates when unauthorized access is attempted.

Features.name: Caltrops
Features.description: A dispenser that releases caltrops to damage pursuing vehicles.

Features.name: Oil Slick
Features.description: A system that releases oil to create a slick surface behind the vehicle.

Features.name: Navigation System
Features.description: A GPS or similar system that assists in navigation.

Powers.name: Cloaking Device
Powers.description: Renders the vehicle invisible to the naked eye and various sensors.

Powers.name: Armored Hull
Powers.description: Provides additional protection through reinforced armor.

Powers.name: Energy Blasters
Powers.description: Powerful energy weapons mounted on the vehicle.

Powers.name: Regeneration Field
Powers.description: A field that accelerates the vehicle's repair processes.

Powers.name: Teleportation Drive
Powers.description: Enables the vehicle to teleport short distances instantly.

Powers.name: Time Travel Capability
Powers.description: Allows the vehicle to travel through time.

Powers.name: Gravity Weapons
Powers.description: Weapons that manipulate gravitational forces to cause damage.

Powers.name: Holographic Disguise
Powers.description: Projects a hologram around the vehicle, altering its appearance.

Powers.name: Quantum Tunneling
Powers.description: Enables the vehicle to phase through solid objects.

Powers.name: Dimensional Phase Shifter
Powers.description: Allows the vehicle to shift into a different dimension temporarily.

Powers.name: Laser Defense System
Powers.description: A defensive system that shoots down incoming projectiles with lasers.

Powers.name: Molecular Disassembler
Powers.description: Breaks down the molecular structure of targeted objects.

Powers.name: Plasma Cannon
Powers.description: A high-powered cannon that fires concentrated plasma.

Powers.name: Smokescreen
Powers.description: Releases a cloud of smoke to obscure vision and confuse pursuers.

Powers.name: Weapons
Powers.description: Standard weapons mounted on the vehicle.

Modifiers.name: Durable
Modifiers.description: The vehicle can take more damage before becoming incapacitated.

Modifiers.name: Minion
Modifiers.description: The vehicle is considered a minion, making it easier to control.

Modifiers.name: Summonable
Modifiers.description: The vehicle can be summoned and dismissed at will.

Modifiers.name: Guzzler
Modifiers.description: The vehicle consumes more fuel than normal, requiring frequent refueling.

Modifiers.name: Hold Together!
Modifiers.description: The vehicle is prone to falling apart under stress.

Modifiers.name: Clunker
